node.statement: Overshoot bound: V<=Phi_s(U)/2. Indeed lambda_j=sigma_s(j)-mu_s(j) by the row-sum coordinate identity, so when lambda_j<0 one has E_s(j)=max(mu_s(j)-lambda_j,0)=sigma_s(j)+2*lambda_j^- >= 2*lambda_j^-; when lambda_j>=0 the term beta_j^+ lambda_j^- is zero. Multiplying by beta_j^+ and summing gives V<=Phi_s(U)/2.
